title: VLSI Design Engineer
summary: A VLSI design engineer writes and checks the RTL code (a hardware description of a chip's logic) that becomes part of a chip, or builds the testbenches that prove it works. In India they usually sit in a design or verification team at a semiconductor company or design-services firm, often starting as freshers with training.
dailyDuties: Write RTL for assigned blocks from a design spec
Build and run simulation testbenches and debug waveforms
Run lint, clock domain crossing and synthesis checks
Fix timing and coverage issues raised in reviews
Script regression runs with Tcl, Perl or Python
Document block behaviour and review specs with the team

skills.expectation: Know logic gates, flip-flops, FSMs and CMOS basics well
Write synthesizable RTL in Verilog and debug it in simulation
Write SystemVerilog testbenches and read UVM environments
Understand synthesis, timing constraints and setup and hold
Run EDA tools and regressions on Linux servers
Automate tool flows with Tcl, Perl or Python
Automate tool flows with Tcl, Perl or Python
Run lint and clock domain crossing checks and fix issues
Design or verify AXI, AHB or APB interfaces
Prototype RTL on FPGA boards with Vivado or Quartus
Build or verify UART, SPI or I2C blocks

groups.label: A flow scripting language (Tcl, Perl or Python)
